body.text: audit.mjs gained a second detector (SHELL_PROBE): children escaping .site-shell / .header-inner. The overflow probe only sees faults that widen the document, so a header 13px wider than its own column reads as clean — that gap let a 128px-wide broken band (desktop nav on at 1081px needing 1161px) survive every prior audit, and the residual spill after the first fix was found by hand, not by the gate
